definitions: A song or composition created by blending two or more pre-recorded songs, typically by overlaying the vocal track of one song onto the instrumental track of another.
A web page or application that combines data or functionality from two or more external sources to create a new service.
A mixture or blend of disparate elements.
examples: The DJ played several creative mashups.
Many websites are essentially mashups of different APIs.
The art exhibit featured mashups of classical and modern styles.
